turns.dialogue: A direct question would be more useful than that assumption.

turns.question: What was your relationship with the victim?
turns.narration: Clara briefly brings her fingertips together.
turns.dialogue: Ordinary business matters were what we disagreed about. Victor and I were business partners.

turns.question: Where were you when the victim died?
turns.dialogue: The library was where I was, trying to read while the storm passed.
